Taylor Fritz: Taylor Fritz enters his recent matches in strong form after claiming his 100th Masters 1000 win against Fils, though he recently suffered a tough defeat to Carlos Alcaraz at the Paris Masters. Squandering match points in that encounter ended his hopes of reaching the ATP Finals. Following this disappointment, Fritz quickly turns his attention back to action with a Stockholm draw against Cameron Norrie.
Holger Rune: Holger Rune enters in strong form, securing a statement opening win in Stockholm just one year after suffering a horrific and scary Achilles injury at the very same venue in 2025. He followed up that opening victory by defeating Miomir Kecmanovic to reach his 40th career quarter-final.
Ugo Humbert: Ugo Humbert started his Stockholm title hunt by avoiding an upset against Adolfo Daniel Vallejo, surviving nine breaks to reach the second round. He has now set up a last-16 clash in the tournament against qualifier Borna Gojo.
Lorenzo Musetti: Lorenzo Musetti enters this match in strong form, highlighted by a notable win over Alexander Zverev at the Paris Masters and an easy victory against Toby Samuel to reach the Stockholm Open quarterfinals. While he missed a major opportunity earlier in Paris, his recent run demonstrates momentum as he continues his campaign in Stockholm.
